written_before: the 2012-2022 out-of-sample run has produced any output; the acquisition chain is still executing
purpose: Fix what each possible outcome means before the outcome exists. Step 222 found the cash-conversion control leg losing to an equal-weight version of its own universe in sample. The 2012-2022 run will either repeat that or contradict it, and both readings are available to be rationalised after the fact unless they are written down first.

what_is_being_tested.why_only_these: the residual sleeve draws on the broad panel, which does not reach before 2022-12 until the running extension completes
what_is_being_tested.benchmark: equal-weight portfolio of the same point-in-time universe, same schedule, same 50bps cost
what_is_being_tested.why_zero: every parameter was frozen before this registry was written; nothing is searched

why_a_backward_test_is_informative: The parameters were chosen on 2023-2026. Applying them to a period whose data played no part in choosing them tests whether the choice generalises. It cannot prove a strategy works, because the data still exists and can be re-examined, but it can show that a parameter set was fitted to one window.

loses_in_both_windows.meaning: the strategy does not select. Fourteen years of underperforming an equal weighting of its own universe is not a regime effect.
loses_in_both_windows.consequence: the control leg should not carry 80% of a composite whose forward clock is about to start, and the protocol needs revisiting before 2026-09-11 rather than after

loses_recently_but_wins_2012_2022.meaning: the in-sample failure is the anomaly, most plausibly because the recent window contained an unusually strong small-capitalisation and technology rally that an equal weighting of 500 names captures and a 20-name book does not
loses_recently_but_wins_2012_2022.consequence: the strategy is a regime bet rather than a dead signal, and must be labelled as one; this does NOT rehabilitate it, because a strategy that only works outside the current regime is not tradable now

wins_in_both_windows.meaning: the Step 222 finding is wrong and something in the in-sample comparison is broken
wins_in_both_windows.consequence: find the defect before believing either result; do not report the favourable one and drop the other

coverage_too_low_to_decide.meaning: the earliest years cannot be priced well enough for the comparison to carry weight
coverage_too_low_to_decide.consequence: report the window that does clear the bar and state plainly which years were excluded and why; do not lower the bar again

forbidden_after_seeing_the_result: restricting the window to a sub-period chosen because it is favourable
